skills.elemental_skill: The special technique of the Yoohoo Ninja Arts! Sayu curls up into a rolling Fuufuu Windwheel and smashes into opponents at high speed, dealing Anemo DMG. When the duration ends, she unleashes a Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick, dealing AoE Anemo DMG. (‍ Press Text for mouse and keyboard and controller ‍/‍ Tap Text for touch screen ‍) Enters the Fuufuu Windwheel state, rolling forward a short distance before using the Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick. Hold Rolls about continuously in the Fuufuu Windwheel state, increasing Sayu's resistance to interruption while within that state. During this time, Sayu can control the direction of her roll, and can use the skill again to end her Windwheel state early and unleash...
skills.elemental_burst: The other super special technique of the Yoohoo Ninja Arts! It summons a pair of helping hands for Sayu.
